title: A little tech demo from another project we’re working on.
author: cristocanaro
selftext:
Just a small sneak peek at something we’ve been working on alongside our other projects.  
Some of you might remember t*hat’s tuff Bruv*, the demo we released a while back. That was actually a separate branch of the same underlying game system.  
The plan is to eventually bring everything together into a larger open-world experience.  
Still very early in development, and there’s a lot left to do with the team.  
Not ready to reveal much more just yet. I’ll let the footage speak for itself.  
Any questions or feedback is welcomed   
More to come. 👀

Cristocanaro \~ Millennium Bug Games

comments.author: Kittingsl
comments.body: This is one thing I have noticed in a few games. The utter text overload som games show you is just silly. How many games do you know that label each button input by name or that sent you like 6 text messages at once blocking 1/4th of the screen? Good game design doesn't need this much text

replies.author: cristocanaro
replies.body: This is at the moment early U/I to understand if the mechanics are actually working, soon most of what you see will be in the backend
